objective: Load canonical quoted and bound outcome facts for one explicit relationship cohort in one bounded batch read and delegate all numerator projection semantics to the pure INS-003S analytics layer.
rules: The caller supplies the explicit relationship cohort.
The application invokes outcome-history batch reading exactly once.
The application does not issue SQL directly.
The application does not append or mutate outcome history.
Relationship cohort canonicalization and outcome validation remain owned by existing canonical layers.
Distinct quoted and bound relationship counting remains owned exclusively by INS-003S.
Current quoteStatus is not used as historical evidence.
Written premium is not used as bound evidence.
No rate or cost-per-outcome calculation occurs in this slice.
